capability.metadata.read.label: Read metadata
capability.metadata.read.description: Read table, column, form, view, plug-in, and solution-layer definitions. Defaults on unless explicitly removed in configuration.
capability.optionValue.add.label: Add option values
capability.optionValue.add.description: Append options to a global option set without changing existing values.
capability.optionValue.updateLabel.label: Update option labels
capability.optionValue.updateLabel.descr: Change display labels only; values and bindings remain unchanged.
capability.optionValue.delete.label: Delete option values
capability.optionValue.delete.descriptio: Delete an option value. The operation fails if records use it, and its label cannot be recovered.
capability.attribute.add.label: Add columns
capability.attribute.add.description: Create table columns of text, integer, decimal, money, boolean, or date/time type.
capability.attribute.update.label: Update column labels
capability.attribute.update.description: Change display name, description, and required level without changing type or data.
capability.attribute.delete.label: Delete columns
capability.attribute.delete.description: Permanently delete a column and its data. Fails when dependencies exist.
capability.entity.update.label: Update table labels
capability.entity.update.description: Change a table display name and description without changing columns or data.
capability.view.columns.label: Update view columns
capability.view.columns.description: Add or remove system-view columns through layoutxml; filters and personal views are unchanged.
capability.layer.remove.label: Remove the active custom layer
capability.layer.remove.description: Remove the top unmanaged Active customization and expose the underlying managed layer. Irreversible.
capability.role.admin.label: Manage security roles
capability.role.admin.description: Assign roles and change role privileges. High risk: incorrect use may expose business data. Requires per-execution confirmation.
capability.message.invoke.label: Invoke messages
capability.message.invoke.description: Invoke custom actions or functions. Plug-ins determine effects and may write data or notify external systems. Requires confirmation.
capability.data.read.label: Read business data
capability.data.read.description: Read business records in addition to metadata. Disabled by default.
capability.data.write.label: Create/update business data
capability.data.write.description: Create or update business records, but not delete them. Requires confirmation and is disabled by default.
config.url.invalid: URL is not a valid address
config.url.queryOrHash: URL cannot contain query parameters or a fragment
config.url.siteRoot: Use the site root URL only; paths such as /main.aspx or /api/data/v9.2 are not allowed
config.env.missingUrl: Environment {key} is missing url and was ignored
config.env.invalidUrl: Environment {key} has an invalid url: {reason}; use a site-root URL such as https://contoso-dev.crm5.dynamics.com
config.env.defaultFallback: defaultEnvironment {requestedDefault} is not in environments; fell back to {fallback}
retention.snapshots.label: Metadata snapshots
retention.snapshots.hint: Keep at least one per environment; the newest snapshot is never deleted.
retention.reports.label: Analysis reports
retention.reports.hint: Contract drift, code-check and migration reports; trend history is never deleted.
retention.diffs.label: Snapshot diff reports
retention.query.label: Query artifacts
retention.query.hint: Per-run evidence from tools; usually large but low value.
retention.changes.label: Write audit
retention.changes.hint: Per-execution ledger; keep longer than other classes.
retention.pathDenied: Path is outside the allowed directory
settingsStore.invalidLimit: {label} must be an integer between {min} and {max}
settingsStore.noConfigFile: The plugin has no configFile and cannot save
settingsStore.noConfigFileHint: Set config.configFile to the absolute path of d365.config.json in cordis.patch.yml.
settingsStore.gitlabHttps: GitLab URL must begin with https://
settingsStore.projectFormat: The default project must use group/project format
settingsStore.urlHint: Use only the site root URL, for example https://contoso-dev.crm5.dynamics.com
writePolicy.configUnreadable: Cannot read config; permissions were not written: {path}
writePolicy.configUnreadableHint: Check file permissions and retry. Nothing was written, so the environment list was not overwritten.
writePolicy.configInvalid: Config is not valid JSON; permissions were not written: {path}
writePolicy.configInvalidHint: Repair the JSON (or remove the file and start over), then save permissions. Nothing was written.
